CANONICAL SQUARE SIGN MEANS: LOCAL ZERO-SOURCE CELL ACQUISITION
foundational_transfer_sol; Sol/max; no descendants; 2026-10-09.
All older packets, including the physical-walk bridge, remain immutable.
Status: new internally reconstructed proof relative to exact named finite
and bulk/cell ancestors. Fresh exposed review is pending. No external,
formal, priority, GFF/interface identification or whole-source claim.

0. WHAT IS NEW, AND WHAT IS NOT ASSUMED

The prior actual ordinary producer is tensor's MODEL_INTERFACE_CLOSURE_PROOF:
zero-pinned square laws and same-domain small tilts, composed with the
conditional cell theorem, give one unmarked continuous path/driver law mu
and its positive scalar A. That producer explicitly excludes arbitrary
bounded pin vectors and sign walls. We do not extend its scope by naming it.

The additional finite input is the general conditioned-sparse theorem and
the frozen-A ordinary-path annealing argument in screened comparison,
section 4. Those apply before numerical wall values are averaged. Together
with a bounded stationary coupling, they allow the local conservative
comparison mechanism to be reconstructed below. The harmonicity is a NEW
composition, not a corollary of a mean range, of zero-boundary GFF convergence,
or of the screened nonlinear positive tail being harmonic.

Read exposure: authorized Luna conditional-harmonicity SOURCE AUDIT, not a
new candidate proof; earlier square producer/bounded-data/screened/sparse
proofs and own cell/terminal ancestors. The source b:cell and b:response
statements are source-reported templates only. No newest walk/trace Luna
candidate is used. Source version is openai/math fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb.

1. EXACT INPUTS AND TARGET

The physical finite model uses only original square NN inequalities
|h_x-h_y|<=1. Original pins have magnitude <=1/2. Let Gamma be the COMPLETE
simple port-resolved negative-corner contour with the same face chord for a
given port pair. The allowed exact geometry says
  {Gamma=s} = {h>0 on C_+(s), h<0 on C_-(s) union T_-(s)}.
An extra negative fourth-corner site in T_- is within NN distance 2 of a
positive cut endpoint. Cut endpoints have an opposite-sign partner at
distance 1. The statement is for sign transcripts, not exact-height or
height-ratio observations, and includes all unqueried graph components.

AMBIENT SCOPE, COMPLETED COMPONENTS, AND A SAME-MEAN COMMON-PIN EXTENSION
Append-only companion to LOCAL_CONDITIONAL_MEAN_HARMONICITY_PROOF.txt.
foundational_transfer_sol; no descendants; 2026-10-09.

Provenance. The local linear-comparison derivation and the main body above
were written before root's warning about variance's slit Arg control. Root
then supplied only that control's theorem-level implication: bounded harmonic
and interior W1p need not have a compatible ambient W1p extension across two
physical banks. No variance proof body was read. The examples and the precise
common-pin extension below are derived here. This does not amend the main
proof, infer a global mean extension, or reopen any frozen earlier packet.

1. THE EXACT COMPLETED-CROSSCUT SCOPE

The acquired target is the canonical COMPLETE Gamma. A proper simple
crosscut divides a disk into two physical observer components. Each of
these sees ONE Gamma bank and its own original boundary arc. Multiple
primal graph components in that physical component do not change this
description. The conditional mean in each component is harmonic by the
local producer. Its Sobolev conclusion is W^{1,p}_loc in that component.

There is no single ambient W1p extension asserted for the combined mean
on BOTH physical components. Even the ideal means +c and -c on the two
half-disks cut by a diameter have a jump along that diameter and cannot be
one W1p function across it. The physical interpolants at finite n join the
two values in a strip of width O(1/n); their energy can grow like n^{p-1}.
Separate component-specific extensions, if proved, may prescribe different
values on the OTHER component. They are not a joint extension of the actual
two-sided conditional mean.

For a PREFIX one observer component can see two opposite Gamma banks. The
main harmonicity mechanism can be localized to compact free buffers in that
component if its exact sign-kernel opposition hypothesis holds. This does
NOT supply a compatible single ambient mean extension through both banks.
In particular it would be false to replace that conclusion by the complete-
component phrase without charging which accesses the same component sees.
